verdict.rationale: Licensing terms for commercial or enterprise use are a fair question for an open-source local LLM runtime, so this story applies. However, the evidence pack contains no license file, pricing page, or statement on whether commercial use is free or needs a paid tier. Mentions of an 'open-tools' page and of organizations deploying 'open-source LLMs' only describe the models and use cases, not llamafile's own license terms.
